name: NGC 4526 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4526, a lenticular galaxy in the Virgo cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4526-hubble
story: A galaxy somewhere between a spiral and an elliptical, with a large disk of dust lying across its center. A colossal supermassive black hole sits at its heart.
